item.title: International Women's Day / Women's History Month Specials
item.description: Produced by: KBOOInternational Women's Day (March 8th) is a global day celebrating the economic, political and social achievements of women past, present and future. International Women's Day honors the work of the suffragettes, feminists, and pioneers who have fought for gender equality. The first International Women's Day event was run in 1911, based on suffragettes campaigning for women's right to vote. item.title: Karen Russell, author of The Antidote (re-broadcast)
item.description: While Jonesy himself recovers from hip surgery, it’s a good time to replay one of my favorite interviews from last year, with one of my very favorite guests, Karen Russell. We talked about her latest novel The Antidote, which was named a 2025 National Book Award finalist in fiction. The paperback edition was just released last week.

item.title: Eugene Veganfest and Blue Barn Farm & Sanctuary
item.description: This show is like taking a virtual preview of the 2nd annual Eugene Veganfest and The Blue Barn Farm & Animal Sanctuary. Join me as Hope Bohanec returns to "That Vegan Show" to share about the Eugene Veganfest (event is on May 3, 2026). Learn about the speakers, vendors, sanctuaries and rescues that will be at the Veganfest. Guest Melissa Patricelli relays how she founded Blue Barn Farm & Sanctuary, shares about the animal residents, and her involvement in the Veganfest.

item.title: John Waters Turns 80
item.description: John Waters is a legendary filmmaker, author, and raconteur whose books include Shock Value, Crackpot, and Liarmouth and whose films include Pink Flamingos, Desperate Living, Hairspray, and Serial Mom. Currently, he's touring behind his one-man show Going to Extremes: A John Waters 80th Birthday Celebration.
